decisive_spans.text: itchy eruptions over the whole body
Multiple nodules appeared on the upper back 1 year previously
Several 0.5- to 1-cm, dome-shaped, red papules and nodules
Small to medium-sized, atypical lymphocytes with focal areas of epidermotropism

response.rationale: The vignette describes a chronic, progressive skin condition with itchy eruptions, nodules, and lymphadenopathy, which are all consistent with Mycosis Fungoides. The histopathology findings of atypical lymphocytes with epidermotropism further support this diagnosis. While Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma is a broader category that includes Mycosis Fungoides, the specific clinical and histopathological features point more directly to Mycosis Fungoides.
